title: Seamist #8
meta_description: Enjoy gulf views from this recently redesigned condo and get ready to put your feet up and let your hair down at this stunning beach retreat.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• GULF FRONT with private beach access for Seamist development• Large covered balcony overlooking the gulf & community grass area• 2 adult rental bikes, complimentary with reservation• Beach Towels Included• Private in-unit washer & dryer• Designated Parking for One Vehicle• High-Speed WIFI• Smart TV w/ NetflixPut your feet up and let your hair down at this beautiful beach retreat. Enjoy gulf views from almost every part of the condo, except the bedroom. You will love the recent remodel done by Tracery Interiors, a famous local interior design firm. Enjoy the Gulf front views and sunsets with a large covered porch when you're not sitting on the beach. The Seamist Condo features one master suite with a QUEEN bed and two additional TWINS off the hallway, cleverly built-in as bunk beds. The kitchen and dining room have an open concept with floor-to-ceiling views of the gulf. With 2 free adult bikes, take a short ride to the Village of South Walton at Seacrest Beach, Alys Beach, or iconic Rosemary Beach.Accommodations (Sleeps 6)• Master Bedroom - 1 Queen Bed, 1 Bath • Built-in twin bunk beds off the main hallway• Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living RoomSeacrest Area Highlights• Located in between Alys Beach/Rosemary Beach & Seagrove Beach• 20-minute bike ride to Seaside Beach• 10-minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach• Shopping & Dining at Villages of South Walton• Weekly live music performances during peak seasons at Villages of South Walton & Alys BeachTDT-079220
